technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (RSI-9, Supertrend, Hull) show bullish bias, but weak trend strength (ADX 20.87), price below key moving averages, and Ichimoku cloud resistance create conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: SPG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 20 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (one sale, two purchases by junior members 117-151 days ago) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (344.6), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event in 1 day adds volatility risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI-9, Supertrend, and Hull momentum signals align bullish with extreme fear sentiment (19/100) offering contrarian opportunity near support at 76.28.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak ADX (20.87), price below EMA-21/SMA-21/VWAP, Ichimoku cloud resistance, zero insider conviction, earnings risk in 20 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, credit stress) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI-9 and Supertrend show short-term bullish momentum at support (76.28) with extreme fear sentiment (19/100) offering contrarian setup. However, weak ADX trend strength (20.87), price below all key moving averages, and Ichimoku cloud resistance create insufficient conviction for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 344.6, credit spread stress) combined with earnings event in 20 days and zero insider conviction create unacceptable event and systemic risk for swing trade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Existing SPG position plus 4 open Real Estate positions (20% sector concentration) argue against adding exposure; portfolio already saturated in sector facing macro headwinds.
